tests.title: Add and remove a product from the cart
tests.goal: A shopper can add a product to the cart, verify the cart line, and remove it without placing an order.
data: A currently listed in-stock, non-booking product

steps.text: Open an in-stock product detail page
Add one unit to the cart
Open the cart and confirm the product line and quantity
Remove the item from the cart

expected.text: The cart shows the selected product with quantity 1 and its price
After removal, the cart is empty and the cart badge shows 0

checks.label: The cart shows the selected product with quantity 1 and its price
After removal, the cart is empty and the cart badge shows 0

notes: Guest, NAKAJIMA cake HKD 0.10: Add To Cart -> "Item added successfully", badge 1, drawer line HKD 0.10 Qty 1. Remove icon -> "Item remove successfully", badge 0, "You have no items in your cart !", still 0 after reload. No order. Remove icon has no accessible name.

tests.title: Guest checkout accepts a plus-addressed email
tests.goal: Valid emails such as name+tag@example.com can place an order, and invalid ones get a field-level message.
preconditions: A non-quota product in the guest cart (e.g. NAKAJIMA cake)
data: Shipping 門市自取, first pickup store, Bank Transfer

steps.text: Open /checkout as a guest and fill First Name, Last Name, Contact Number
Enter a plus-addressed email (name+tag@example.com) in Your Details
Choose 門市自取, a pickup store and an address, Bank Transfer, tick 結帳前同意

expected.text: The order is placed and the thank-you page shows the order number
If an email is rejected, the message names the Email field and the reason

checks.label: The order is placed and the thank-you page shows the order number
If an email is rejected, the message names the Email field and the reason

notes: chan.taiman+<id>@example.com -> "Please fill all required info", Email labels red, no text (twice). Without "+" the order was placed (TXN0126102700016).
